query_original: computer vision — machines that understand images and video

scope.disambiguation_notes: The query is interpreted as referring to the field of computer vision, which involves enabling machines to interpret and understand visual information from the world, such as images and videos.
initial_task_hypotheses: A computer vision system must be able to detect and recognize objects within images or video streams.
A computer vision system must be capable of interpreting spatial relationships and context within visual data.
A computer vision system must be able to track movement and changes in visual scenes over time.
A computer vision system must be able to segment images into meaningful parts or regions for further analysis.
A computer vision system must be able to enhance or restore images to improve visual quality or extract more information.

search_plan.rationale: To establish a clear and authoritative definition of computer vision.
To identify the various subfields and specializations within computer vision.
To understand the fundamental techniques and methods used in computer vision.
To explore the practical applications and use cases of computer vision technology.

search_plan.query_en: difference between computer vision and image processing
search_plan.rationale: To distinguish computer vision from related fields like image processing, which do not encompass the full scope of understanding visual content.

search_plan.query_en: CPC IPC classification codes for computer vision
search_plan.rationale: To find the official classification codes that categorize computer vision technologies.
To identify alternative terms and synonyms used for computer vision.
